title: Pin the exact ls byte-truncation branch in regression coverage
outcome: The complete-envelope test checks totals, omitted counts and byte size but does not require the verbose fixture to trim or assert the byte-bounded hint. Strengthen the discriminating assertions without loosening existing checks.
acceptance: phoenix_list_reports_exact_counts_and_fits_the_complete_envelope explicitly asserts fewer than 25 verbose rows and the exact byte-bounded hint, alongside both complete-envelope byte limits.

completion.summary: The verbose list regression now explicitly requires byte trimming and the exact byte-bounded hint, alongside total/omitted/more consistency and full pretty-JSON/text envelope caps. The zero-row regression pins both surface hints and continuation guidance. All fixture and import/style failures encountered during iteration were classified and corrected without relaxing assertions.
